title: Update all dependencies in all languages to their latest versions
body:
Fixes #348.

This updates every dependency in all eight bindings to its latest release. It covers direct and dev dependencies, every lockfile entry, build plugins, linters, actions, runner and base images, and the toolchains themselves. The update also tests every floor the repository declares. Six of those claims were false on `main`, and the new runner image and release checks exposed two more defects. All eight are fixed here. All bindings move to **0.27.0** together.

All evidence is in [`dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/tree/issue-348-a1c0fc463277/dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349). Start with [`analysis/REQUIREMENTS.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-348-a1c0fc463277/dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/analysis/REQUIREMENTS.md), which lists every requirement from the issue with the commit that meets it.

## Pinned vs latest, per ecosystem

[`data/changes.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-348-a1c0fc463277/dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/data/changes.md) has the issue's table for every ecosystem. It lists every declared dependency with three versions: before, after, and the registry's latest on 2026-10-16. `experiments/issue-348/inventory.py` built it from the registries (npm, crates.io, PyPI, NuGet, Packagist, Maven Central, the Go proxy, GitHub releases), not from memory.

Of the 177 declarations in active and archived manifests, 171 are current and 5 are removed. One is behind on purpose: `experiments/issue-316/rust-timing` pins `links-notation =0.21.1`, because that is the baseline the experiment times against.

Most direct dependencies were already current, because the freshness gate from #325 fails CI on any lag. The changes:

| Ecosystem | Change |
| --- | --- |
| npm | eslint 10.13.0 (`js`, `docs/website`, and now pinned in the pre-commit hook), gpt-tokenizer 4.0.3. Every compatible transitive entry is refreshed in the five `package-lock.json` files and `js/bun.lock` |
| Cargo | syn 3.0.9. **Edition 2024** and resolver 3 for every crate, with shared `[workspace.package]` metadata (`cargo fix --edition`, 2024 style edition). `rust-version` stays 1.87, the real floor (`usize::is_multiple_of`); `check-msrv.sh` still proves 1.86 is rejected. All experiment crates are on edition 2024 with fresh lockfiles |
| PyPI | **`requires-python >=3.11`**, because 3.9 and 3.10 are end of life. CI tests 3.11 and 3.15. The 3.9 shims are removed: `tomllib` replaces a regex `pyproject.toml` reader, one `setuptools>=84.0.0` replaces two markers, and the gate's `pypi-py39` resolver is gone. zizmor 1.31.1 |
| NuGet | SDK 10.0.402 pinned in `csharp/global.json`, which CI, setup-dotnet and Gitpod all read. Microsoft.ML.Tokenizers 2.0.1. Removed packages: `Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub` (the SDK ships Source Link; `experiments/issue-348/sourcelink-sdk.sh` shows identical output), the `Microsoft.Bcl.Memory` security pin (tokenizers 2.0.1 no longer pulls the vulnerable version) and the dead `net4*` reference assemblies. Archived experiments move from net8.0 (end of life 2026-11-10) to net10.0 |
| Composer | phpunit 13.4.3; both lockfiles current |
| Maven | central-publishing-maven-plugin 0.12.0. **Maven itself is now pinned** with the Maven Wrapper (3.10.0, SHA-256), and `maven-enforcer-plugin` declares the 3.6.3 floor (D6 below) |
| Go | **`go 1.26`** in every module, because 1.24 and 1.25 are unsupported. `go fix` modernizers are applied (`range` over int, `strings.SplitSeq`, `slices.Backward`, `errors.AsType`, `max`, `new(expr)`), and CI fails when `go fix -diff` reports a pending one. testify 1.12.1 in `benchmarks/go` replaces the 1.8.2 that tiktoken-go's own tests pulled in |
| GitHub Actions | setup-java v6.1.0, codeql-action v4.39.0 (all others were current). Runners move from `ubuntu-24.04` to `ubuntu-26.04` and from `macos-15` to `macos-26`. Tool jobs run Node 24 LTS, Python 3.15, JDK 25, PHP 8.5 and Go 1.27 |
| Java runtimes | Tests on JDK 21 (the floor), 25 (LTS) and 27 (newest) |
| pre-commit | Every hook `rev` was already its newest tag. The eslint hook is fixed (D2) |
| Docker / Gitpod | `gitpod/workspace-dotnet` is pinned by tag and digest instead of `latest`, and installs the SDK `global.json` pins (D3) |
| C++ / CMake | GoogleTest v1.18.0 and clang-format 23.1.3 were current. The 3.16 floor is now tested (D1) |
| Dependabot | Covers every committed manifest: 12 ecosystems, with bun, dotnet-sdk, pre-commit and docker added. `scripts/ci/check-dependabot.py` fails CI when a manifest has no entry (D4) |

[`analysis/TOOLCHAINS.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-348-a1c0fc463277/dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/analysis/TOOLCHAINS.md) gives, for every language, the declared floor, the versions tested, and the newest release. The rule applied: **CI tests the declared floor and the newest release, and tool jobs run the newest supported release.**

## Left behind, with reasons

- **Node 26 for tool jobs.** Node 26 is a Current line until it becomes LTS on 2026-10-28, so CI stays on Node 24 LTS.
- **Maven 4.0.0.** It is still a release candidate (rc-7). **macOS 27** has no GitHub runner label yet.
- **Transitive lockfile entries.** Some are held back by ranges in packages that are themselves on their latest release: mostly under eslint, and also under peggy, cacheable, `@types/node` and postcss. The NuGet ones come from the xunit test platform. Forcing them with `overrides` would run code against majors its authors never tested. Each one is listed, with the range that holds it, in [`analysis/TRANSITIVE.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-348-a1c0fc463277/dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/analysis/TRANSITIVE.md). Cargo, Composer, Maven and Go have none left; the Go details are in the same file.
- **latexminted 0.7.x for the C# PDF.** TeX Live 2025 on ubuntu-26.04 bundles latexminted 0.6.0, which fails on the system Python 3.14. latexminted 0.7.0 fixes that, but it needs minted.sty 3.8.0 and TeX Live 2025 ships 3.7.0 (gpoore/minted#478). So the PDF job runs the bundled script on Python 3.13. The step prints a warning asking for its own removal once Ubuntu's package works again (D7).
- **`dev/log` snapshots** of other repositories' pipeline templates keep their versions. They are evidence for #290 and #330, and they never build here.

## Upstream reports

[`upstream/README.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-348-a1c0fc463277/dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/upstream/README.md) indexes them. Every local workaround stays in place, so no upstream release blocks this pull request.

- Filed: jaredwray/cacheable#1739 (`@cacheable/memory` holds `keyv` and `@keyv/bigmap` on old majors) and link-foundation/lino-objects-codec#74 (the codec pins `links-notation` 0.25.x).
- Already tracked upstream, so not filed again:
  - eslint/eslint#21338 and eslint/eslint#17733
  - microsoft/testfx#7465
  - rhysd/actionlint#682: actionlint does not know `ubuntu-26.04`; `.github/actionlint.yaml` declares the label
  - diffplug/spotless#3126 and google/google-java-format#1478: the existing `format` profile workaround stays
  - dependabot/dependabot-core#14812: Maven Wrapper updates are behind a rollout flag; the freshness gate tracks the wrapper
  - [Launchpad bug 2154292](https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/texlive-extra/+bug/2154292) and gpoore/minted#463 (with #478): Ubuntu's latexminted fails on Python 3.14; the PDF job's Python 3.13 wrapper stays

## Defects the update uncovered

Details, root causes and logs are in [`analysis/DEFECTS.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-348-a1c0fc463277/dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/analysis/DEFECTS.md).

| # | Defect on `main` | Reproduce on `main` | Fix and its test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D1 | `cpp/` claims CMake 3.16, but the test build does not configure below 3.24 (`DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP`) | `cmake -S cpp -B build` with CMake 3.16.9 | `cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16...4.4)` sets CMP0135 and replaces the keyword. The new `cpp / cmake-floor` job builds, tests and consumes with 3.16.9 |
| D2 | The pre-commit `eslint` hook installs an unpinned ESLint and fails on every run | `pre-commit run eslint --all-files` | Pinned to `eslint@10.13.0` and run on the two configured projects. The gate checks `additional_dependencies` |
| D3 | The Gitpod image (`latest`, .NET SDK 8.0.100) cannot build the `net10.0` projects | `dotnet --version` in the workspace | Image pinned by digest. `dotnet-install --jsonfile csharp/global.json` |
| D4 | 35 committed manifests had no Dependabot entry | `scripts/ci/check-dependabot.py` | Every directory is listed, and the check runs in CI |
| D5 | `requires-python >=3.9`, but the `test` extra cannot install on 3.9, and CI only ran 3.13 | `pip install -e 'python[test]'` on 3.9 | Floor 3.11, tested in CI |
| D6 | Maven was neither pinned nor given a true floor ("Maven 3.6+", but the plugins need 3.6.3) | `versions:display-plugin-updates` warns that no minimum is defined | Maven Wrapper 3.10.0, `requireMavenVersion` 3.6.3, and a `java / maven-floor` job. 3.6.3 passes 185/185 tests, and 3.6.2 is refused |
| D7 | The C# PDF does not build on ubuntu-26.04: a 2019 `fvextra.sty` shadows TeX Live's, then latexminted 0.6.0 fails on Python 3.14 | CI 38946567310 and 38949537786 (logs in `ci-logs/ci/`); `experiments/issue-348/latexminted-python314.sh` | TeX Live's fvextra is used, and latexminted runs on Python 3.13. The PDF job now builds on every PR and renders 112 pages |
| D8 | The `cpp_0.26.0` release asset is an empty archive (125 bytes) | `cd cpp && git archive --format=tar HEAD:cpp \| tar -t` lists nothing | `scripts/ci/cpp-release-archive.sh` archives from the top level and refuses an archive without `CMakeLists.txt`. `cpp.yml` builds a consumer from it on every PR, and `cpp-release-archive.test.sh` runs it from three directories |

**Limit:** the D3 fix was verified only up to `dotnet --version` printing `10.0.402` inside the pinned image. The Docker daemon then stopped in this environment and could not be restarted, so the full C# suite has not run *inside* the Gitpod image. It passes on SDK 10.0.402 outside Docker.

## Needs a maintainer on `main`

These cannot be done from a pull request. CI on this PR passes without them, and CI on `main` fails with an `::error::` that says what to do:

- **Java 0.26.0 is missing from Maven Central.** Configure `CENTRAL_USERNAME`, `CENTRAL_TOKEN`, `GPG_PRIVATE_KEY` and `GPG_PASSPHRASE` for the verified `io.github.link-foundation` namespace, then re-run the main CI run.
- **PHP 0.26.0 is missing from Packagist.** Submit the repository once at https://packagist.org/packages/submit and configure `PACKAGIST_USERNAME` and `PACKAGIST_TOKEN`, then re-run the main CI run.

Both publish jobs already said this, but the release audit only printed "java: 0.26.0 is absent from Maven Central". Its errors on `main` now name the setup and the re-run (`scripts/release-audit.mjs`, tested in `experiments/issue-339/release-audit.test.mjs`).

- **The empty `cpp_0.26.0` asset (D8)** stays, because the workflow never replaces a published asset. Remove it with `gh release delete-asset cpp_0.26.0 links-notation-cpp-0.26.0.tar.gz` and the same for its `.sha256`. Release 0.27.0 gets a correct archive.

## Security audits

[`analysis/AUDITS.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-348-a1c0fc463277/dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/analysis/AUDITS.md) records **no open advisory in any ecosystem**. The tools used were `npm audit` (five trees), `cargo audit` (every lockfile), `dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive` (plus `--deprecated`), `composer audit`, `govulncheck`, `pip-audit`, OSV for the resolved Maven trees, the Maven distribution and the wrapper, and zizmor on the workflows.

## Release preparation

- Every binding declares **0.27.0**; `node scripts/version-consistency.mjs` reports "All 8 implementations declare 0.27.0". This is a minor release because the Python 3.11 and Go 1.26 floors break consumers on older versions.
- `benchmarks/BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md` was regenerated with the generator, not edited.
- The changelog fragment is `changelog.d/348.md`, with an entry in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `experiments/issue-348/prepare_release.py` records the version bump.

## How to verify

```bash
python3 scripts/ci/check-dependencies.py            # every declared pin is the registry's latest
node scripts/ci/check-npm-locks.mjs                 # every npm lockfile entry
python3 scripts/ci/check-dependabot.py              # every manifest has a Dependabot entry
node scripts/ci/check-parity.mjs                    # parity contract, 0 violations
node scripts/version-consistency.mjs                # all 8 bindings at 0.27.0
python3 experiments/issue-348/inventory.py dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/data/after   # regenerate the inventory
python3 experiments/issue-348/changes.py dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/data           # and the before/after table
```

Local build, test, lint and audit logs for every ecosystem are in `ci-logs/deps/` and `ci-logs/audit/`.

## CI

All checks pass on 55cd76a:

- [CI 38952685571](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/38952685571): 69 jobs succeeded. Only the main-only `release` and `benchmarks / publish` jobs were skipped. The run covers the new `cpp / cmake-floor` and `java / maven-floor` jobs, the C++ release-archive consumer in `cpp / test (gcc)`, and `csharp / generatePdfWithCode`, which renders the 112-page PDF.
- [workflows 38952685200](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/38952685200): actionlint, shellcheck, zizmor, the Dependabot coverage check, and the registry-probe and release-archive script tests.
- [dependency freshness 38952685050](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/38952685050), [links](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/38952685322), [bom-check](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/38952685028), [pages](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/38952685378).

Logs of the earlier failing runs this PR fixed are in `dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349/ci-logs/`.
